html:
The Fafnar Cultists are humans from Kilmaresh that started to worship the god Fafnar as their only god and above Suon, even though the Kilmareshian believe both gods to be equal. This resulted in a civil war between the Fafnar followers and those who fought for the duality of the two sun gods. Ultimately, the war was ended by Suon himself.
